items.question: How much solar capacity is installed in Freiburg im Breisgau?
items.answer:

The total includes small rooftop systems, which have no public coordinates, so it can't be fully shown on the map. If you want the picture over time, I can pull the cumulative growth chart for the city.

items.question: How has battery storage capacity in Freiburg grown since 2015? What is the total installed power now?
items.answer:
Battery storage in Freiburg has grown steadily since 2015, with a sharp jump in 2023. Cumulative installed net capacity was 0.18 MW in 2015, 0.95 MW in 2019, 3.94 MW in 2022, 9.77 MW in 2023, 14.91 MW in 2024, 19.74 MW in 2025 and 25.45 MW in 2026 so far. The total today is **25.45 MW** across 4,138 units, with about 40.6 MWh of usable storage. Those 4,138 units are almost certainly mostly small home batteries, which carry no public coordinates, so I can't map most of them.

The chart shows the full time series. Figures are net capacity for units in operation, with decommissioned units removed. The 2026 value reflects the snapshot date (23 Nov 2026), so that year is incomplete.
